name: @atlasauth/pca-less-wasm
description: LESS (code-equivalence, NIST additional-signature Round 2 candidate) signature backend for @atlasauth/pca: the official LESS reference C compiled to WebAssembly with a portable, dependency-free loader (Node >=20, browsers, Deno, Bun, edge). Verified by the official KATs, a native-vs-wasm differential, sanitizers and robustness tests; unaudited, not a standard.

scripts.build:wasm: echo 'wasm is cross-compiled off-box by scripts/lessbuild.sh on a Linux VM (wasi-sdk-25); drop the result into wasm/less_cat1.wasm, then run: node scripts/embed-wasm.mjs' && exit 1
scripts.build: node scripts/embed-wasm.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json
